name: helios
description: Physically-based Monte Carlo path tracer in TypeScript with next-event estimation + MIS, GGX materials, textures, meshes, transforms and worker-thread rendering; zero runtime dependencies, deterministic PNG output, and a physics-validated test suite

scripts.render:all: npm run build && node dist/cli.js render scenes/cornell.json --out renders/cornell.png --workers 4 && node dist/cli.js render scenes/spheres.json --out renders/spheres.png --workers 4 && node dist/cli.js render scenes/night.json --out renders/night.png --workers 4 && node dist/cli.js render scenes/showcase.json --out renders/showcase.png --workers 4
